_comment: UGV MCP config — edit to enable and restrict tools
_note_enable: Set mcp_enabled=true and add tools to allowed_tools to unlock them
_note_token: Token is in config/.mcp_token — share it with Claude via MCP client config
_note_danger: Dangerous tools (move_robot, start_wireguard, load_wireguard_config, etc.) always need confirm=true even when in allowed_tools
